message.content: Columbia University is a private Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. It was founded in 1754 as King's College and became Columbia College in 1784 after the American Revolution. Today it is one of the world’s leading academic institutions, known for its rigorous undergraduate and graduate programs across a wide range of disciplines, including humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, engineering, business, law, medicine, and journalism. Its main campus is situated on Morningside Heights in Manhattan, with additional campuses in Washington, D.C., and elsewhere. Columbia is also home to several prestigious research centers and institutes, and its alumni include numerous Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and U.S. presidents.
